name: Portable Sunglasses Box
description: Made from EVA - a synthetic material, this Semi-Hard Case can protect your lenses from scratches and its arms from bending and breaking. The soft lining is also great for protecting your lenses from dirt and residue. A carabiner-style keychain clip conveniently attaches the glasses case to your handbag, backpack or tote bag to carry your reading glasses, goggles or any eyewear. As well as use it as a multipurpose storage tool for small electronics, accessories, or other small items. This product is fit for most standard sized glasses, sunglasses, computer glasses and more, ultra-lightweight that adds minimum bulk and weight while on the go or carrying around.
